backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a booking backend with admin-gated access control; exposes `createBooking` (public) and `getAllBookings` (admin-only) using an in-memory Map store.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two completed features — Instagram footer link and SEO meta tags — to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of one-sentence summaries for every frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes used across the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags (title, description, Open Graph, Twitter Card, robots) for public search engine discoverability.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with two routes: `/` (HomePage) and `/admin` (AdminPage).
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingsTa: Admin component rendering all bookings as a responsive desktop table and mobile card list with formatted service/category labels and status badges.
frontend/src/components/booking/BookingF: Booking form component with service/category selects, customer inputs, date picker, validation, loading state, and a success confirmation screen showing the booking ID.
frontend/src/components/home/AboutSectio: Renders the 'About Us' section of the homepage with a two-column layout containing descriptive text about Omm Vedic Numerology and a grid of four feature cards highlighting key attributes.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Renders the full-screen hero section with a background image, animated stars, Om symbol, main heading, tagline, and two CTA buttons for booking and exploring services.
frontend/src/components/home/ServiceCard: Displays a single service card with an icon, name, descriptions, price, and a 'Book Now' button that triggers the onBookNow callback with the service ID.
frontend/src/components/home/ServicesSec: Renders the services section with a header and a responsive grid of ServiceCard components sourced from the services data, plus a pricing note footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Fixed navigation header with logo, desktop nav links, a subtle admin icon link, and a collapsible mobile menu; navigation triggers scroll-to-section via the onNavigate callback.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines the ServiceData interface and exports an array of four service objects (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu Shastra, Pronology), each priced at ₹400 with descriptions and icon paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides two React Query hooks—useIsCallerAdmin to check if the current user is an admin, and useGetAllBookings to fetch all bookings when the caller is confirmed as admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a `useCreateBooking` mutation hook using React Query that calls the backend actor's `createBooking` method and invalidates the bookings cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, and defines a cosmic dark theme with gold accent CSS custom properties and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that handles Internet Identity login/logout, checks if the caller is an admin, and displays a bookings table with refresh functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main public-facing page composing the header, hero, services, about, and booking form sections with smooth scroll navigation and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the theme with custom fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), a cosmic/gold color palette using oklch, custom shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for accordion, twinkle, and float effects.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (version 7) describing 'Omm Vedic Numerology', a spiritual services booking website with features for homepage, booking form, services/pricing, visual theme, and an in-progress admin panel for managing bookings.
